# Stripe financial reconciliation operations

**Status:** Plan 6B candidate — independent review pending

This guide covers the minimized Stripe ledger, deterministic financial allocations, payout association, recovery scans, and restore checks now joined with administrator report routes, refund review/finalization, reporting corrections, CSV export, payout views, and narrowly scoped recovery grants in one Plan 6B candidate. The direct Sales routes are available only to authorized candidate review; global navigation remains `Sales — Upcoming` with no live link. Production remains closed in `APPLICATION_MODE=maintenance` with Stripe disabled. For surface semantics and safe operator actions, see [financial reconciliation and reporting](financial-reconciliation-and-reporting.md).

The committed migration chain ends at `0013`. Migration `0012` retains its historical eight callable public boundary routines and `0013` adds only the ninth correction-resolution routine. The exact pairwise-distinct principals are `DATABASE_OWNER_USER`, `DATABASE_USER`, `DATABASE_WORKER_USER`, and `DATABASE_STORAGE_CLEANUP_USER`. The web principal submits commands, reads owner-scoped status, and records route-authorized audit evidence; only the financial worker executes protected mutations. Candidate release evidence must run in this order: migrate → provision → checkpoint capture → distinct-engine rehearsal → smoke. Plan 7 remains the production-activation and operability phase.

## Provider boundary and webhook configuration

The Stripe SDK and the Dashboard webhook endpoint are pinned to API version `2026-07-29.dahlia`. Keep the existing Plan 6A event allowlist and add exactly these six payout events:

- `payout.created`
- `payout.updated`
- `payout.paid`
- `payout.failed`
- `payout.canceled`
- `payout.reconciliation_completed`

Never subscribe the endpoint to `*`. `payout.reconciliation_completed`, not `payout.paid` by itself, is the signal that exact automatic-payout membership can be queried. Webhook acceptance verifies the signature and API version, persists a minimized event, and atomically enqueues the existing Stripe-event job. It does not retrieve a Payout or Balance Transaction in the request.

The worker uses four durable job families:

- `commerce.financial-source` reconciles one local payment, refund, or dispute from complete canonical provider state.
- `commerce.financial-payout` refreshes one payout and imports supported membership one page at a time.
- `commerce.financial-scan` discovers bounded recovery work, resumes checkpoints, and fans out payout-generation impacts.
- `commerce.financial-classification` appends a decision for one immutable local ledger subject. It never calls Stripe.

Every provider retrieve or list call runs outside an active database transaction. Short staging, import-run, and checkpoint transactions may occur between calls; provider facts are staged independently before purchase-linked projection enters the ordered local purchase graph. Reports read only PostgreSQL; they never make a live provider call.

### Source flow

1. A payment job retrieves the PaymentIntent, latest Charge, and Charge Balance Transaction; a refund job retrieves the complete Refund plus its principal and failure Balance Transactions; a dispute job retrieves the complete Dispute plus every observed withdrawal or reinstatement transaction.
2. The adapter rejects unexpected livemode, amount, currency, source linkage, timestamp, and money relationships and returns only canonical minimized snapshots.
3. Each Balance Transaction and fee-detail set is inserted once or checked byte-for-byte against immutable local evidence. Novel classifications remain durable as `unsupported_category` instead of being guessed.
4. A short ordered transaction re-reads local purchase facts, appends deterministic gross and fee allocation sets, recomputes issues, and advances payout-independent evidence to `fee_reconciled` only when complete.
5. Current `payout_reconciled` is derived at read time from authoritative membership and the payout's current canonical state. It is never stored on a payment, refund, or dispute.

Out-of-order and duplicate events converge because workers reduce complete canonical objects, not event deltas. Ingestion never invents title attribution: an ambiguous succeeded multi-title refund remains `needs_review + pending` with `allocation_incomplete` until an authorized reviewer uses the named refund workflow through the controlled candidate surface. Direct SQL mutation remains forbidden.

### Payout flow and exact association

A payout event or scan first retrieves and stages the canonical payout and any payout/failure Balance Transaction. Exact membership is published only when all of these conditions hold under the final lock:

- the payout is automatic;
- its method is `standard`;
- its reconciliation status is `completed`;
- its current canonical status is `paid`;
- payout-filtered pagination reached a complete final page; and
- every candidate passed parsing, immutable-collision, and one-payout-per-transaction checks.

Page entries in `payout_import_run_entries` are provisional and are not settlement authority. One atomic publication transaction locks the payout, run, sorted entries, sorted Balance Transactions, membership rows, and payout issues; inserts `stripe_payout_balance_transactions`; marks the run published; increments the payout generation; enqueues its generation-specific impact scan; and appends the minimized audit event. A crash before this transaction leaves no partial authoritative membership. A replay emits neither another generation nor another publication audit.

A later failed, canceled, or reversed payout preserves historical membership but immediately reopens current derived state because reads join the current payout. Its failure/reversal evidence is imported separately. Do not delete the original rows.

Manual payouts and instant payouts have no Stripe-determined exact transaction membership in this model. Once their source Balance Transactions and fees are complete they remain `fee_reconciled`, meaning **not payout reconciled**. Never assign their transactions to a payout manually or infer membership from timing or amount.

## Recurrence, freshness, and recovery

When Stripe runtime is enabled, every worker polling loop safely ensures one provider-recovery root for the current UTC hour. Its permanent key includes the hour, so multiple workers converge on one row while the next hour can recover work that an earlier terminal key cannot suppress. Each scan transaction handles at most 100 local resources or one provider page of at most 100 records, commits its phase/checkpoint, and enqueues a distinct continuation.

The initial payout discovery lower bound is seven days before the earliest local paid order, or seven days before the current scan hour when no paid order exists. It is not an unrestricted Stripe-account backfill and not merely "the last seven days." Each run freezes its provider time window before the first request. The singleton durable coverage high-water advances only with the terminal discovery page; subsequent hourly discovery starts with a 72-hour overlap from the older of that high-water and the scan hour, so delayed evidence and outages longer than 72 hours cannot create an unscanned gap. Local source scans also cover pending/retryable payments, refunds, and disputes plus incomplete payout import runs and open payout-reversal issues.

Each deployed classifier/allocation pair has a separate composite replay root such as `commerce.financial-classification:scan:1:1`. It processes local immutable evidence only. Unsupported classifications are not retried every hour; deploying a newer supported classifier or allocation-algorithm version creates a new version-keyed replay that appends decisions and successor allocation tips without editing history.

Job attempt ceilings are 12 for source jobs, 12 for payout jobs, 8 for scan jobs, and 5 for classification jobs. Retryable provider or state failures use bounded backoff. If attempts are exhausted, the failed job remains durable:

- the next UTC-hour root can rediscover a still-pending source using a new hour-specific key;
- incomplete payout runs are rediscovered and resumed from their committed page;
- a payout lifecycle or publication change uses a new payout-generation key; and
- an unsupported classification waits for a new deployed classifier/allocation version rather than looping hourly.

An active-entity guard prevents parallel event/hour/generation jobs from mutating the same source. Permanent evidence conflicts remain exceptions until changed canonical evidence or a specifically authorized named Plan 6B workflow proves the invariant. There is no manual sync, arbitrary retry, or SQL status-reset procedure; Plan 7 owns general failed-job controls.

"Financial data through" means the completion time of the last successful relevant local discovery scan. It does not mean live Stripe state, guarantee that every child job succeeded, or erase open/pending issues. Interpret it together with source state, incomplete import runs, open issues, and failed financial jobs. Safe aggregate inspection is:

```sql
select
  kind,
  max(completed_at) filter (where state = 'completed') as last_completed_at,
  count(*) filter (where state = 'running') as running_count,
  count(*) filter (where state = 'exception') as exception_count
from financial_scan_runs
group by kind
order by kind;
```

## Signed money and currency domains

All money is a JavaScript-safe integer in the currency's minor unit; code uses `BigInt` intermediates for allocation and stable largest-remainder rounding. No code assumes two decimal places.

For every Stripe Balance Transaction:

```text
net_minor = amount_minor - fee_minor
```

- `amount_minor` is the signed gross Stripe-balance movement.
- `fee_minor` is nonnegative provider fee evidence.
- `net_minor` is the signed net Stripe-balance movement.
- A gross allocation set targets `amount_minor`; a fee allocation set targets `-fee_minor` so fees reduce estimated revenue.
- Sales and fee credits are positive effects. Refund principal, dispute withdrawals, and charged fees are negative effects. Failed-refund reversals and dispute reinstatements are positive effects when the provider movement is positive.

Presentment and settlement are separate domains even when both currency codes happen to match:

- **Presentment** is what the customer paid and comes from immutable orders, order items, refund allocations, and dispute facts.
- **Settlement** is what moved through the Stripe balance and comes from Balance Transactions, fees, adjustments, and payouts.

Never add unlike currencies or treat one domain as a converted equivalent of the other. An exchange rate is retained only as bounded exact decimal evidence; actual provider settlement amounts are allocated without JavaScript floating-point conversion. Customer sales tax stays separate from title revenue. Account-level adjustments can affect payout/account totals but are never attributed to a title.

## Reconciliation issues and safe inspection

`financial_reconciliation_issues` contains internal resource IDs, bounded codes, `open | resolved` state, `pending | exception | informational` impact, timestamps, occurrence count, and a correlation ID. The complete Plan 6B issue vocabulary is:

| Code | Meaning and operator disposition |
| --- | --- |
| `allocation_fork` | More than one allocation-chain tip is visible. Keep read-only and investigate replay/version history. |
| `allocation_incomplete` | Expected attribution is not finalized, commonly an ambiguous refund. Authorized reviewers use only the named refund workflow; ingestion and direct SQL never guess attribution. |
| `allocation_mismatch` | Signed totals, capacities, or persisted allocation shape do not conserve. Treat as an exception. |
| `classification_fork` | Multiple global allocation tips exist for a Balance Transaction, or an exact replay target contradicts immutable classification evidence on its selected allocation set. Treat as an exception. |
| `correction_rebase_required` | A preserved reporting correction is incompatible with an exact replacement allocation set. Use only the named correction workflow after reviewing compatible canonical evidence. |
| `currency_mismatch` | Currency domains or linked rows disagree. Do not convert or rewrite values. |
| `generation_exhausted` | A payout reached the bounded generation ceiling. Keep closed and escalate as a software/data incident. |
| `immutable_mismatch` | Canonical evidence collides with an existing immutable fact. Compare minimized lineage; never overwrite it. |
| `missing_source` | Required local or canonical evidence is not yet present. Check worker/provider recovery and freshness. |
| `payout_incomplete` | A payout import has not obtained a complete publishable page set. Let checkpoint recovery resume it. |
| `payout_membership_conflict` | One Balance Transaction was claimed by competing supported payouts. Treat as an exception. |
| `payout_reversal_incomplete` | A failed/canceled payout lacks complete reversal evidence. Wait for canonical recovery. |
| `source_linkage_mismatch` | Canonical provider evidence cannot be proven to belong to the expected local source. Treat as an exception. |
| `unsupported_category` | One immutable classification-version row records evidence that its classifier could not safely classify. The row-specific diagnostic remains historical and open; use the active-only query below to decide whether it is a current blocker. |

Inspect only minimized operational fields:

```sql
select id, resource_type, resource_id, safe_code, state, impact,
  first_observed_at, last_observed_at, occurrence_count, correlation_id, resolved_at
from financial_reconciliation_issues
where state = 'open'
order by last_observed_at desc, id
limit 100;

with active as (
  select classifier_version, allocation_algorithm_version
  from financial_projection_versions
  where singleton = true
), active_classifications as (
  select classification.id
  from financial_classification_versions classification
  cross join active
  left join stripe_balance_transactions balance
    on classification.subject_type = 'balance_transaction'
   and balance.id = classification.subject_id
   and balance.fingerprint_sha256 = classification.source_fingerprint_sha256
  left join stripe_balance_transaction_fee_details detail
    on classification.subject_type = 'fee_detail'
   and detail.id = classification.subject_id
   and detail.fingerprint_sha256 = classification.source_fingerprint_sha256
  where classification.classifier_version = active.classifier_version
    and (balance.id is not null or detail.id is not null)
), active_allocation_tips as (
  select allocation.id
  from financial_allocation_sets allocation
  cross join active
  where allocation.classifier_version = active.classifier_version
    and allocation.algorithm_version = active.allocation_algorithm_version
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from financial_allocation_sets successor
      where successor.supersedes_set_id = allocation.id
        and successor.classifier_version = allocation.classifier_version
        and successor.algorithm_version = allocation.algorithm_version
    )
)
select issue.id, issue.resource_type, issue.resource_id, issue.safe_code,
  issue.state, issue.impact, issue.first_observed_at, issue.last_observed_at,
  issue.occurrence_count, issue.correlation_id, issue.resolved_at
from financial_reconciliation_issues issue
where issue.state = 'open'
  and (
    issue.resource_type not in ('financial_classification', 'allocation_set')
    or (issue.resource_type = 'financial_classification' and exists (
      select 1 from active_classifications active where active.id = issue.resource_id
    ))
    or (issue.resource_type = 'allocation_set' and exists (
      select 1 from active_allocation_tips active where active.id = issue.resource_id
    ))
  )
order by issue.last_observed_at desc, issue.id
limit 100;

select id, type, status, attempts, max_attempts, run_at, completed_at, updated_at
from jobs
where type in (
  'commerce.financial-source',
  'commerce.financial-payout',
  'commerce.financial-scan',
  'commerce.financial-classification'
)
order by updated_at desc, id
limit 100;
```

The first query is a historical inventory: a retired classifier's immutable `unsupported_category` fact remains open and is not a current blocker merely because a newer classifier is active. The second query is the current operational queue. It retains non-versioned issue resources, but includes a classification-row issue only when that row belongs to the active classifier and the subject's current raw fingerprint, and includes an allocation-set issue only when that exact set is a raw tip under the active classifier/allocation pair. It deliberately derives raw tips rather than trusting `current_financial_projection_heads.base_set_id`, because an issue on the selected set makes that view hide the ID. The orphan check below proves every historical unknown row owns its exact permanent issue; the active decision diagnostic independently proves current unknown-to-issue cardinality.

Do not select job payloads, provider IDs for support output, raw events, provider messages, descriptions, metadata, customer identity, emails, card/billing/address data, receipt URLs, action URLs, secrets, or request/response bodies. Do not enable Stripe SDK HTTP logging.

There is no generic Resolve action. An issue resolves only in the same transaction where canonical recomputation proves its exact invariant after new provider evidence, a reviewed classifier replay, refund finalization, or a validated reporting correction. An `unsupported_category` issue on a `financial_classification` resource is different: it is the immutable truth about that exact historical row and never resolves; a later classifier writes a different row and only the active row participates in current triage. Acknowledgment alone cannot advance state. Direct database edits, deleting history, editing issue state, blessing a classifier row, assigning payout membership, or resetting a failed job are unsupported repair paths.

## Coordinated backup and restore

### Post-restore executable schema-object check

This canonical `plan6b-financial-catalog-v3` manifest is executable restore evidence for every protected migration journal entry with `idx >= 7` through `0013_plan6bii_reporting_correction_authority`. It rejects missing, additional, or catalog-different protected tables, views, enum labels, touched legacy columns, routine signatures and definitions, triggers, constraints, and explicit indexes. It also rejects the two retired enum types and three retired reconciliation columns. The contract pins physical table/view kind and persistence, row-security state, created-object owners, exact non-owner direct ACLs including normalized grantors, the canonical 16-tuple database-owner default-ACL inventory, and the effective `STORAGE_CLEANUP_LOGIN` group/login authority boundary. Each protected table fingerprints sorted full constraint, inbound-foreign-key, non-constraint-owned index, noninternal trigger, rewrite-rule, and inheritance-edge inventories. Constraint-owned indexes are represented through their constraints, with the primary key repeated as a dedicated table-shape field, while every explicit `CREATE INDEX` remains an independent catalog object.

The v3 boundary preserves every v2 descriptor and fully fingerprints the new correction-only issue resolver, including its source definition, database owner, `SECURITY DEFINER` mode, `pg_catalog` search path, and worker-only direct `EXECUTE` ACL. It also pins the changed `jobs` SELECT boundary, all nine callable administrator routines, the six private/trigger helpers, and the five new triggers. A forbidden-column witness rejects any `capability_token` field, so the clear lease capability remains process memory only and the database stores only its lowercase SHA-256 digest. The four legacy relations in the 0010 direct-ACL boundary (`outbox_messages`, `guest_identities`, `entitlement_grants`, and `entitlements`) additionally pin ordinary-table, permanent-storage, and disabled-RLS state. Their owners are intentionally treated as part of the trusted database-owner/restore boundary because the migrations do not canonicalize legacy ownership; their non-owner ACL grantors are still exact. RLS policy rows are not separately inventoried because both RLS flags are pinned off, making policies behaviorally inactive.

The database-level ACL retains PostgreSQL's canonical non-grantable `PUBLIC CONNECT` and `PUBLIC TEMPORARY` entries, alongside direct non-grantable `CONNECT` for the three fixed groups. `PUBLIC` receives no application schema, relation, column, routine, or default privilege; configured application logins receive no direct ACL.

correction.base_allocation_set_id = command_base_set_id\n    AND correction.source_fingerprint_sha256 = command_source_fingerprint\n    AND correction.approved_by_admin_id = command_row.actor_user_id\n    AND correction.created_by_admin_id = command_row.actor_user_id\n    AND correction.correlation_id = command_row.correlation_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '55000',\n      MESSAGE = 'reporting correction does not match its administrator command';\n  END IF;\n\n  WITH RECURSIVE active_projection_version AS (\n    SELECT projection.classifier_version, projection.allocation_algorithm_version\n    FROM \"public\".\"financial_projection_versions\" projection\n    WHERE projection.singleton = true\n      AND projection.pending_classifier_version IS NULL\n      AND projection.pending_allocation_algorithm_version IS NULL\n      AND projection.pending_replay_id IS NULL\n      AND projection.pending_scan_run_id IS NULL\n  ), eligible_allocation_sets AS (\n    SELECT allocation_set.*\n    FROM \"public\".\"financial_allocation_sets\" allocation_set\n    CROSS JOIN active_projection_version projection\n    WHERE allocation_set.classifier_version = projection.classifier_version\n      AND allocation_set.algorithm_version = projection.allocation_algorithm_version\n  ), eligible_base_tips_unranked AS (\n    SELECT allocation_set.*\n    FROM eligible_allocation_sets allocation_set\n    WHERE NOT EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 FROM eligible_allocation_sets successor\n      WHERE successor.supersedes_set_id = allocation_set.id\n    )\n  ), eligible_base_tips AS (\n    SELECT tip.*,\n      pg_catalog.count(*) OVER (\n        PARTITION BY tip.balance_transaction_id, tip.basis\n      ) AS tip_count\n    FROM eligible_base_tips_unranked tip\n  ), refund_presentment_components AS (\n    SELECT allocation.refund_id, allocation.order_item_id,\n      allocation.currency, component.component, component.amount_minor\n    FROM \"public\".\"refund_allocation_components\" allocation\n    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES\n      ('refund_subtotal'::\"public\".\"financial_component\", allocation.subtotal_minor),\n      ('refund_tax'::\"public\".\"financial_component\", allocation.tax_minor)\n    ) component(component, amount_minor)\n  ), correction_tip_candidates AS (\n    SELECT correction.*\n    FROM \"public\".\"refund_reporting_correction_sets\" correction\n    WHERE EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 FROM eligible_allocation_sets anchor\n      WHERE anchor.id = correction.base_allocation_set_id\n    ) AND NOT EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1\n      FROM \"public\".\"refund_reporting_correction_sets\" successor\n      JOIN eligible_allocation_sets successor_anchor\n        ON successor_anchor.id = successor.base_allocation_set_id\n      WHERE successor.predecessor_correction_set_id = correction.id\n    )\n  ), correction_prevalidation AS (\n    SELECT correction.*,\n      correction_refund.payment_id AS refund_payment_id,\n      correction_refund.currency AS refund_currency,\n      correction_payment.order_id AS refund_order_id,\n      CASE WHEN EXISTS (\n        SELECT 1 FROM \"public\".\"refund_reporting_correction_items\" correction_item\n        WHERE correction_item.correction_set_id = correction.id\n      ) AND correction_refund.status = 'succeeded' AND\n        correction_refund.currency = correction_payment.currency AND\n        anchor.id IS NOT NULL AND anchor.tip_count = 1 AND\n        anchor.basis = 'gross_amount'::\"public\".\"financial_allocation_basis\" AND\n        anchor.source_kind = 'refund'::\"public\".\"financial_allocation_source_kind\" AND\n        anchor.source_internal_id = correction.refund_id AND\n        anchor.source_fingerprint_sha256 = correction.source_fingerprint_sha256\n      THEN 0 ELSE 1 END::bigint AS invalid_refund_context_count,\n      (\n        SELECT pg_catalog.count(*)\n        FROM \"public\".\"refund_reporting_correction_items\" correction_item\n        LEFT JOIN eligible_base_tips item_source\n          ON item_source.id = correction_item.source_allocation_set_id\n        WHERE correction_item.correction_set_id = correction.id\n          AND correction_item.domain = 'settlement'\n          AND (item_source.id IS NULL OR item_source.tip_count <> 1 OR\n            item_source.source_kind <> 'refund'::\"public\".\"financial_allocation_source_kind\" OR\n            item_source.source_internal_id <> correction.refund_id OR\n            item_source.source_fingerprint_sha256 <> correction.source_fingerprint_sha256 OR\n            correction_item.currency <> item_source.currency OR\n            (item_source.basis =\n              'gross_amount'::\"public\".\"financial_allocation_basis\" AND\n              correction_item.component NOT IN (\n                'refund_subtotal'::\"public\".\"financial_component\",\n                'refund_tax'::\"public\".\"financial_component\"\n              )) OR\n            (item_source.basis = 'fee'::\"public\".\"financial_allocation_basis\" AND\n              correction_item.component <>\n                'refund_fee'::\"public\".\"financial_component\") OR\n            item_source.basis NOT IN (\n              'gross_amount'::\"public\".\"financial_allocation_basis\",\n              'fee'::\"public\".\"financial_allocation_basis\"\n            ))\n      ) AS invalid_settlement_source_count,\n      (\n        SELECT pg_catalog.count(*)\n        FROM (\n          SELECT correction_item.domain,\n            correction_item.source_allocation_set_id, correction_item.currency\n          FROM \"public\".\"refund_reporting_correction_items\" correction_item\n          WHERE correction_item.correction_set_id = correction.id\n          GROUP BY correction_item.domain,\n            correction_item.source_allocation_set_id, correction_item.currency\n          HAVING pg_catalog.sum(correction_item.delta_minor::bigint) <> 0\n        ) invalid_delta_group\n      ) AS invalid_delta_group_count,\n      (\n        SELECT pg_catalog.count(*)\n        FROM \"public\".\"refund_reporting_correction_items\" correction_item\n        LEFT JOIN eligible_base_tips item_source\n          ON item_source.id = correction_item.source_allocation_set_id\n        WHERE correction_item.correction_set_id = correction.id AND (\n          NOT EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM \"public\".\"order_items\" order_item\n            WHERE order_item.id = correction_item.order_item_id\n              AND order_item.order_id = correction_payment.order_id\n              AND (correction_item.domain <> 'presentment' OR\n                order_item.currency = correction_item.currency)\n          ) OR (correction_item.domain = 'presentment' AND\n            correction_item.currency <> correction_refund.currency) OR\n          correction_item.stable_tie_break_key IS DISTINCT FROM CASE\n            WHEN correction_item.domain = 'presentment' THEN\n              'presentment:' || correction_item.order_item_id::text || ':' ||\n                correction_item.component::text\n            WHEN item_source.basis = 'gross_amount' THEN\n              'settlement:gross:' || correction_item.order_item_id::text || ':' ||\n                correction_item.component::text\n            WHEN item_source.basis = 'fee' THEN\n              'settlement:fee:' || correction_item.order_item_id::text || ':' ||\n                correction_item.component::text\n            ELSE NULL\n          END\n        )\n      ) AS invalid_order_item_or_tie_count,\n      (\n        SELECT pg_catalog.count(*)\n        FROM \"public\".\"refund_reporting_correction_items\" correction_item\n        LEFT JOIN \"public\".\"financial_item_allocations\" base_item\n          ON base_item.allocation_set_id = correction_item.source_allocation_set_id\n         AND base_item.order_item_id = correction_item.order_item_id\n         AND base_item.component = correction_item.component\n        WHERE correction_item.correction_set_id = correction.id\n          AND correction_item.domain = 'settlement' AND (\n            correction_item.approved_absolute_minor::bigint <>\n              COALESCE(base_item.effect_minor, 0)::bigint +\n                correction_item.delta_minor::bigint OR\n            (base_item.id IS NOT NULL AND base_item.currency <> correction_item.currency) OR\n            (base_item.id IS NULL AND correction_item.approved_absolute_minor = 0)\n          )\n      ) AS invalid_settlement_arithmetic_count,\n      (\n        SELECT pg_catalog.count(*)\n        FROM \"public\".\"financial_item_allocations\" base_item\n        WHERE base_item.effect_minor <> 0 AND EXISTS (\n          SELECT 1\n          FROM \"public\".\"refund_reporting_correction_items\" source_item\n          WHERE source_item.correction_set_id = correction.id\n            AND source_item.domain = 'settlement'\n            AND source_item.source_allocation_set_id = base_item.allocation_set_id\n        ) AND NOT EXISTS (\n          SELECT 1\n          FROM \"public\".\"refund_reporting_correction_items\" correction_item\n          WHERE correction_item.correction_set_id = correction.id\n            AND correction_item.domain = 'settlement'\n            AND correction_item.source_allocation_set_id = base_item.allocation_set_id\n            AND correction_item.order_item_id = base_item.order_item_id\n            AND correction_item.component = base_item.component\n            AND correction_item.currency = base_item.currency\n        )\n      ) AS missing_settlement_base_count,\n      (\n        SELECT pg_catalog.count(*)\n        FROM \"public\".\"refund_reporting_correction_items\" correction_item\n        LEFT JOIN refund_presentment_components base_component\n          ON base_component.refund_id = correction.refund_id\n         AND base_component.order_item_id = correction_item.order_item_id\n         AND base_component.component = correction_item.component\n        WHERE correction_item.correction_set_id = correction.id\n          AND correction_item.domain = 'presentment' AND (\n            correction_item.approved_absolute_minor < 0 OR\n            correction_item.approved_absolute_minor::bigint <>\n              COALESCE(base_component.amount_minor, 0)::bigint +\n                correction_item.delta_minor::bigint OR\n            (base_component.refund_id IS NOT NULL AND\n              base_component.currency <> correction_item.currency) OR\n            (base_component.refund_id IS NULL AND\n              correction_item.approved_absolute_minor = 0)\n          )\n      ) AS invalid_presentment_arithmetic_count,\n      (\n        SELECT pg_catalog.count(*)\n        FROM refund_presentment_components base_component\n        WHERE base_component.refund_id = correction.refund_id\n          AND base_component.amount_minor <> 0 AND EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1\n            FROM \"public\".\"refund_reporting_correction_items\" presentment_item\n            WHERE presentment_item.correction_set_id = correction.id\n              AND presentment_item.domain = 'presentment'\n          ) AND NOT EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1\n            FROM \"public\".\"refund_reporting_correction_items\" correction_item\n            WHERE correction_item.correction_set_id = correction.id\n              AND correction_item.domain = 'presentment'\n              AND correction_item.order_item_id = base_component.order_item_id\n              AND correction_item.component = base_component.component\n              AND correction_item.currency = base_component.currency\n          )\n      ) AS missing_presentment_base_count\n    FROM correction_tip_candidates correction\n    JOIN \"public\".\"refunds\" correction_refund\n      ON correction_refund.id = correction.refund_id\n    JOIN \"public\".\"payments\" correction_payment\n      ON correction_payment.id = correction_refund.payment_id\n    LEFT JOIN eligible_base_tips anchor ON anchor.id = correction.base_allocation_set_id\n  ), prevalidated_correction_tips AS (\n    SELECT correction.*,\n      (correction.invalid_refund_context_count +\n       correction.invalid_settlement_source_count +\n       correction.invalid_delta_group_count +\n       correction.invalid_order_item_or_tie_count +\n       correction.invalid_settlement_arithmetic_count +\n       correction.missing_settlement_base_count +\n       correction.invalid_presentment_arithmetic_count +\n       correction.missing_presentment_base_count)::bigint AS invalid_noncapacity_count\n    FROM correction_prevalidation correction\n  ), effective_presentment_components AS (\n    SELECT effective_refund.payment_id, base_component.refund_id,\n      base_component.order_item_id, base_component.component,\n      base_component.currency, base_component.amount_minor::bigint AS effect_minor\n    FROM refund_presentment_components base_component\n    JOIN \"public\".\"refunds\" effective_refund\n      ON effective_refund.id = base_component.refund_id\n    WHERE effective_refund.status = 'succeeded' AND NOT EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 FROM prevalidated_correction_tips correction\n      WHERE correction.refund_id = base_component.refund_id\n        AND correction.invalid_noncapacity_count = 0 AND EXISTS (\n          SELECT 1\n          FROM \"public\".\"refund_reporting_correction_items\" correction_item\n          WHERE correction_item.correction_set_id = correction.id\n            AND correction_item.domain = 'presentment'\n        )\n    )\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT correction.refund_payment_id, correction.refund_id,\n      correction_item.order_item_id, correction_item.component,\n      correction_item.currency,\n      correction_item.approved_absolute_minor::bigint AS effect_minor\n    FROM prevalidated_correction_tips correction\n    JOIN \"public\".\"refund_reporting_correction_items\" correction_item\n      ON correction_item.correction_set_id = correction.id\n     AND correction_item.domain = 'presentment'\n    WHERE correction.invalid_noncapacity_count = 0\n  ), presentment_capacity_status AS (\n    SELECT effect.payment_id, effect.order_item_id, effect.component,\n      effect.currency, pg_catalog.sum(effect.effect_minor)::bigint AS cumulative_effect_minor,\n      CASE effect.component\n        WHEN 'refund_subtotal'::\"public\".\"financial_component\"\n          THEN order_item.unit_subtotal_minor\n        WHEN 'refund_tax'::\"public\".\"financial_component\"\n          THEN COALESCE(order_item.tax_minor, 0)\n        ELSE 0\n      END::bigint AS capacity_minor\n    FROM effective_presentment_components effect\n    JOIN \"public\".\"order_items\" order_item ON order_item.id = effect.order_item_id\n    GROUP BY effect.payment_id, effect.order_item_id, effect.component,\n      effect.currency, order_item.unit_subtotal_minor, order_item.tax_minor\n  ), current_correction_tips AS (\n    SELECT correction.*,\n      (correction.invalid_noncapacity_count + (\n        SELECT pg_catalog.count(*)\n        FROM \"public\".\"refund_reporting_correction_items\" correction_item\n        LEFT JOIN presentment_capacity_status capacity\n          ON capacity.payment_id = correction.refund_payment_id\n         AND capacity.order_item_id = correction_item.order_item_id\n         AND capacity.component = correction_item.component\n         AND capacity.currency = correction_item.currency\n        WHERE correction_item.correction_set_id = correction.id\n          AND correction_item.domain = 'presentment' AND (\n            capacity.order_item_id IS NULL OR capacity.cumulative_effect_minor < 0 OR\n            capacity.cumulative_effect_minor > capacity.capacity_minor\n          )\n      ))::bigint AS invalid_correction_count\n    FROM prevalidated_correction_tips correction\n  ), command_items AS (\n    SELECT (item.value ->> 'orderItemId')::uuid AS order_item_id,\n      (item.value ->> 'totalPresentmentMinor')::integer AS total_presentment_minor\n    FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(command_row.private_input -> 'items') item(value)\n  ), raw_chain AS (\n    SELECT correction.id, correction.predecessor_correction_set_id,\n      correction.correction_version\n    FROM \"public\".\"refund_reporting_correction_sets\" correction\n    WHERE correction.id = correction_row.id\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT predecessor.id, predecessor.predecessor_correction_set_id,\n      predecessor.correction_version\n    FROM \"public\".\"refund_reporting_correction_sets\" predecessor\n    JOIN raw_chain successor ON predecessor.id = successor.predecessor_correction_set_id\n  )\n  SELECT (\n    current_tip.id = correction_row.id AND current_tip.invalid_correction_count = 0 AND\n    (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) FROM active_projection_version) = 1 AND\n    (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) FROM raw_chain) = command_next_version AND\n    (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*)\n      FROM \"public\".\"refund_reporting_correction_sets\" correction\n      WHERE correction.refund_id = command_refund_id) = command_next_version AND\n    (SELECT pg_catalog.min(correction_version) FROM raw_chain) = 1 AND\n    (SELECT pg_catalog.max(correction_version) FROM raw_chain) = command_next_version AND\n    NOT EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 FROM raw_chain chain\n      WHERE (chain.correction_version = 1) IS DISTINCT FROM\n        (chain.predecessor_correction_set_id IS NULL)\n    ) AND NOT EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 FROM \"public\".\"refund_reporting_correction_sets\" successor\n      WHERE successor.predecessor_correction_set_id = correction_row.id\n    ) AND (\n      (command_next_version = 1 AND correction_row.predecessor_correction_set_id IS NULL) OR\n      EXISTS (\n        SELECT 1 FROM \"public\".\"refund_reporting_correction_sets\" predecessor\n        WHERE predecessor.id = correction_row.predecessor_correction_set_id\n          AND predecessor.refund_id = command_refund_id\n          AND predecessor.correction_version = command_next_version - 1\n      )\n    ) AND\n    (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) FROM command_items) = (\n      SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) FROM \"public\".\"order_items\" order_item\n      JOIN \"public\".\"payments\" payment ON payment.order_id = order_item.order_id\n      JOIN \"public\".\"refunds\" refund ON refund.payment_id = payment.id\n      WHERE refund.id = command_refund_id\n    ) AND NOT EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 FROM command_items requested\n      LEFT JOIN \"public\".\"order_items\" order_item ON order_item.id = requested.order_item_id\n      LEFT JOIN \"public\".\"payments\" payment ON payment.order_id = order_item.order_id\n      LEFT JOIN \"public\".\"refunds\" refund\n        ON refund.payment_id = payment.id AND refund.id = command_refund_id\n      WHERE refund.id IS NULL OR requested.total_presentment_minor IS DISTINCT FROM (\n        SELECT COALESCE(\n          pg_catalog.sum(correction_item.approved_absolute_minor), 0\n        )::integer\n        FROM \"public\".\"refund_reporting_correction_items\" correction_item\n        WHERE correction_item.correction_set_id = correction_row.id\n          AND correction_item.domain = 'presentment'\n          AND correction_item.order_item_id = requested.order_item_id\n      )\n    ) AND (SELECT pg_catalog.sum(total_presentment_minor) FROM command_items) = (\n      SELECT refund.amount_minor FROM \"public\".\"refunds\" refund\n      WHERE refund.id = command_refund_id AND refund.status = 'succeeded'\n    )\n  ) IS TRUE INTO correction_is_compatible\n  FROM current_correction_tips current_tip\n  WHERE current_tip.id = correction_row.id;\n\n  IF correction_is_compatible IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '55000',\n      MESSAGE = 'reporting correction compatibility proof failed';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO issue_row\n  FROM \"public\".\"financial_reconciliation_issues\" issue\n  WHERE issue.id = requested_issue_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '55000',\n      MESSAGE = 'financial issue is outside the reporting-correction command scope';\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(pg_catalog.hashtext(\n    'pale-orbit:financial:issue:' || issue_row.resource_type || ':' ||\n      issue_row.resource_id::text || ':' || issue_row.safe_code\n  ));\n  SELECT * INTO issue_row\n  FROM \"public\".\"financial_reconciliation_issues\" issue\n  WHERE issue.id = requested_issue_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n  WITH RECURSIVE current_selected_set_lineage(id) AS (\n    SELECT selected_set.id\n    FROM \"public\".\"financial_allocation_sets\" selected_set\n    WHERE issue_row.resource_type = 'allocation_set'\n      AND selected_set.id = issue_row.resource_id\n      AND selected_set.source_kind = 'refund'\n      AND selected_set.source_internal_id = command_refund_id\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT successor.id\n    FROM \"public\".\"financial_allocation_sets\" successor\n    JOIN current_selected_set_lineage predecessor\n      ON successor.supersedes_set_id = predecessor.id\n    WHERE successor.source_kind = 'refund'\n      AND successor.source_internal_id = command_refund_id\n  ), current_refund_sets AS MATERIALIZED (\n    SELECT allocation_set.id\n    FROM \"public\".\"financial_allocation_sets\" allocation_set\n    JOIN \"public\".\"financial_projection_versions\" projection_version\n      ON projection_version.singleton = true\n     AND projection_version.pending_classifier_version IS NULL\n     AND projection_version.pending_allocation_algorithm_version IS NULL\n     AND projection_version.pending_replay_id IS NULL\n     AND projection_version.pending_scan_run_id IS NULL\n     AND allocation_set.classifier_version = projection_version.classifier_version\n     AND allocation_set.algorithm_version =\n       projection_version.allocation_algorithm_version\n    WHERE allocation_set.source_kind = 'refund'\n      AND allocation_set.source_internal_id = command_refund_id\n      AND NOT EXISTS (\n        SELECT 1 FROM \"public\".\"financial_allocation_sets\" successor\n        WHERE successor.supersedes_set_id = allocation_set.id\n      )\n  )\n  SELECT (\n    issue_row.state = 'open' AND issue_row.safe_code IN (\n      'allocation_fork', 'allocation_incomplete', 'allocation_mismatch',\n      'classification_fork', 'correction_rebase_required', 'currency_mismatch',\n      'immutable_mismatch', 'missing_source', 'source_linkage_mismatch'\n    ) AND (\n      (issue_row.resource_type = 'refund' AND\n        issue_row.resource_id = command_refund_id) OR\n      (issue_row.resource_type = 'allocation_set' AND EXISTS (\n        SELECT 1 FROM current_selected_set_lineage lineage\n        JOIN current_refund_sets current_set ON current_set.id = lineage.id\n      ))\n    )\n  ) IS TRUE INTO allowlisted_issue;\n  IF allowlisted_issue IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '55000',\n      MESSAGE = 'financial issue is outside the reporting-correction command scope';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM pg_catalog.set_config(\n    'pale_orbit.plan6bii_financial_admin_issue_resolution_command_id',\n    command_row.id::text, true\n  );\n  PERFORM pg_catalog.set_config(\n    'pale_orbit.plan6bii_financial_admin_issue_resolution_issue_id',\n    issue_row.id::text, true\n  );\n  PERFORM pg_catalog.set_config(\n    'pale_orbit.plan6bii_financial_admin_issue_resolution_actor_id',\n    command_row.actor_user_id::text, true\n  );\n  UPDATE \"public\".\"financial_reconciliation_issues\"\n  SET state = 'resolved', resolved_by_admin_id = command_row.actor_user_id,\n    resolved_at = pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()\n  WHERE id = issue_row.id AND state = 'open'\n  RETURNING * INTO resolved_issue;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RETURN;\n  END IF;\n  INSERT INTO \"public\".\"audit_events\" (\n    actor_type, actor_id, action, outcome, resource_type, resource_id,\n    correlation_id, after\n  ) VALUES (\n    'user'::\"public\".\"audit_actor_type\", command_row.actor_user_id::text,\n    'financial.issue.resolved', 'succeeded'::\"public\".\"audit_outcome\",\n    'financial_issue', resolved_issue.id::text, command_row.correlation_id,\n    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(\n      'resourceType', resolved_issue.resource_type,\n      'resourceId', resolved_issue.resource_id,\n      'safeCode', resolved_issue.safe_code,\n      'impact', resolved_issue.impact,\n      'state', resolved_issue.state,\n      'occurrenceCount', resolved_issue.occurrence_count,\n      'commandId', command_row.id\n    )\n  );\n  RETURN NEXT resolved_issue;\n  RETURN;\nEND;\n$function$\n", "volatility": "v", "security_definer": true, "identity_arguments": "uuid, uuid"}$catalog$::jsonb),

  ('enum', 'public', null, 'financial_admin_command_status', null, 'a26535e0d8fc84e51ceecb203873bb9996c5e7372d54b77ea3ff08f945ee7943', $catalog${"acl": [{"grantee": "DATABASE_OWNER", "grantor": "DATABASE_OWNER", "grantable": false, "privilege": "USAGE"}, {"grantee": "PUBLIC", "grantor": "DATABASE_OWNER", "grantable": false, "privilege": "USAGE"}], "owner": "DATABASE_OWNER", "labels": ["pending", "succeeded", "denied", "conflict", "failed"]}$catalog$::jsonb),
  ('table', 'public', null, 'financial_admin_commands', null, '1605b99430631aeff236f0a8f1df9c9ff58fb6faf34f13428f29e822feaa0f36', $catalog${"acl": [{"grantee": "DATABASE_OWNER", "grantor": claim.job_id = requested_job_id\n    AND claim.capability_sha256 = supplied_digest\n    AND claim.generation BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647\n    AND claim.attempt BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647\n    AND claim.state = 'active'\n    AND claim.invalidated_at IS NULL\n    AND claim.expires_at > pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()\n    AND job.type = 'commerce.financial-admin-command'\n    AND job.status = 'running'\n    AND job.attempts = claim.attempt\n    AND job.locked_at IS NOT NULL\n    AND job.locked_by IS NOT NULL\n    AND job.payload IS NOT DISTINCT FROM\n      pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('commandId', command.id)\n    AND job.deduplication_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM\n      'commerce:financial-admin-command:' || command.id::text || ':v1'\n    AND job.max_attempts = 8;\n  IF authority_count IS DISTINCT FROM 1 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '55000',\n      MESSAGE = 'financial administrator job lease authority is not current';\n  END    AND claim.invalidated_at >=\n          COALESCE(claim.renewed_at, claim.issued_at)\n        AND claim.attempt = persisted_job.attempts\n        AND persisted_job.status = 'running'\n        AND   ('function', 'public', null, 'resolve_financial_issue_after_admin_command', 'uuid, uuid', 'aa0345b4dde25ae6a2ec17bc65e5b3cdc578c5d1bf1eeb4784ce8c42dedeca2b', $catalog${"acl": [{"grantee": "leakproof": false, "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resolve_financial_issue_after_admin_command(uuid, uuid)\n RETURNS SETOF financial_reconciliation_issues\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  requested_command_id uuid := $1;\n  requested_issue_id uuid := $2;\n  command_job_id uuid;\n  locked_command_id uuid;\n  locked_actor_user_id uuid;\n  locked_correlation_id text;\n  locked_command_status \"public\".\"financial_admin_command_status\";\n  command_row \"public\".\"financial_admin_commands\"%ROWTYPE;\n  issue_row \"public\".\"financial_reconciliation_issues\"%ROWTYPE;\n  resolved_issue \"public\".\"financial_reconciliation_issues\"%ROWTYPE;\n  command_refund_id uuid;\n  allowlisted_issue boolean := false;\nBEGIN\n  IF NOT pg_catalog.pg_has_role(\n    session_user, 'pale_orbit_financial_worker', 'MEMBER'\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '42501',\n      MESSAGE = 'financial administrator issue transition is not permitted';\n  END IF;\n  IF requested_command_id IS NULL OR requested_issue_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '22023',\n      MESSAGE = 'invalid financial administrator issue transition';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(\n    pg_catalog.hashtext('pale-orbit:user-roles:admin')\n  );\n  SELECT command.job_id INTO command_job_id\n  FROM \"public\".\"financial_admin_commands\" command\n  WHERE command.id = requested_command_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RETURN;\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock_shared(pg_catalog.hashtextextended(\n    'pale-orbit:plan6bii-financial-admin-job-lease:' || command_job_id::text, 0\n  ));\n  SELECT command.id, command.actor_user_id, command.correlation_id, command.status\n  INTO locked_command_id, locked_actor_user_id,\n    locked_correlation_id, locked_command_status\n  FROM \"public\".\"financial_admin_commands\" command\n  WHERE command.id = requested_command_id\n    AND command.job_id = command_job_id\n    AND command.kind = 'refund_allocation_finalize'\n    AND command.status = 'pending'\n  FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RETURN;\n  END IF;\n  IF NOT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM \"public\".\"user_roles\" role_row\n    WHERE role_row.user_id = locked_actor_user_id AND role_row.role = 'admin'\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '42501',\n      MESSAGE = 'financial administrator capability is not current';\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM \"public\".\"plan6bii_assert_financial_admin_job_lease\"(command_job_id);\n  SELECT * INTO command_row\n  FROM \"public\".\"financial_admin_commands\" command\n  WHERE command.id = locked_command_id\n    AND command.job_id = command_job_id\n    AND command.kind = 'refund_allocation_finalize'\n    AND command.actor_user_id = locked_actor_user_id\n    AND command.correlation_id = locked_correlation_id\n    AND command.status = locked_command_status;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '55000',\n      MESSAGE = 'invalid financial administrator issue command';\n  END IF;\n  IF NOT ((\n    pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(command_row.private_input) = 'object' AND\n    command_row.private_input ?& ARRAY[\n      'kind','refundId','expectedActiveDraftVersion','previewFingerprint','confirmation'\n    ]::text[] AND\n    command_row.private_input - 'kind' - 'refundId' - 'expectedActiveDraftVersion' -\n      'previewFingerprint' - 'confirmation' = '{}'::jsonb AND\n    pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(command_row.private_input -> 'kind') = 'string' AND\n    command_row.private_input ->> 'kind' = 'refund_allocation_finalize' AND\n    pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(command_row.private_input -> 'refundId') = 'string' AND\n    CASE WHEN pg_catalog.pg_input_is_valid(\n        command_row.private_input ->> 'refundId', 'uuid'\n      ) THEN (command_row.private_input ->> 'refundId')::uuid::text =\n        command_row.private_input ->> 'refundId' ELSE false END AND\n    pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(\n      command_row.private_input -> 'expectedActiveDraftVersion'\n    ) = 'number' AND\n    CASE WHEN pg_catalog.pg_input_is_valid(\n        command_row.private_input ->> 'expectedActiveDraftVersion', 'integer'\n      ) THEN (command_row.private_input ->> 'expectedActiveDraftVersion')::integer\n        BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647 ELSE false END AND\n    pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(command_row.private_input -> 'previewFingerprint') = 'string' AND\n    command_row.private_input ->> 'previewFingerprint' ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND\n    pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(command_row.private_input -> 'confirmation') = 'string' AND\n    command_row.private_input ->> 'confirmation' = 'finalize_refund_allocation'\n  ) IS TRUE) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '55000',\n      MESSAGE = 'invalid financial administrator issue command';\n  END IF;\n  command_refund_id := (command_row.private_input ->> 'refundId')::uuid;\n\n  SELECT * INTO issue_row\n  FROM \"public\".\"financial_reconciliation_issues\" issue\n  WHERE issue.id = requested_issue_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '55000',\n      MESSAGE = 'financial issue is outside the administrator command scope';\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(pg_catalog.hashtext(\n    'pale-orbit:financial:issue:' || issue_row.resource_type || ':' ||\n      issue_row.resource_id::text || ':' || issue_row.safe_code\n  ));\n  SELECT * INTO issue_row\n  FROM \"public\".\"financial_reconciliation_issues\" issue\n  WHERE issue.id = requested_issue_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n  WITH RECURSIVE current_selected_set_lineage(id) AS (\n    SELECT selected_set.id\n    FROM \"public\".\"financial_allocation_sets\" selected_set\n    WHERE issue_row.resource_type = 'allocation_set'\n      AND selected_set.id = issue_row.resource_id\n      AND selected_set.source_kind = 'refund'\n      AND selected_set.source_internal_id = command_refund_id\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT successor.id\n    FROM \"public\".\"financial_allocation_sets\" successor\n    JOIN current_selected_set_lineage predecessor\n      ON successor.supersedes_set_id = predecessor.id\n    WHERE successor.source_kind = 'refund'\n      AND successor.source_internal_id = command_refund_id\n  ), current_refund_sets AS MATERIALIZED (\n    SELECT allocation_set.id\n    FROM \"public\".\"financial_allocation_sets\" allocation_set\n    JOIN \"public\".\"financial_projection_versions\" projection_version\n      ON projection_version.singleton = true\n     AND projection_version.pending_classifier_version IS NULL\n     AND projection_version.pending_allocation_algorithm_version IS NULL\n     AND projection_version.pending_replay_id IS NULL\n     AND projection_version.pending_scan_run_id IS NULL\n     AND allocation_set.classifier_version = projection_version.classifier_version\n     AND allocation_set.algorithm_version =\n       projection_version.allocation_algorithm_version\n    WHERE allocation_set.source_kind = 'refund'\n      AND allocation_set.source_internal_id = command_refund_id\n      AND NOT EXISTS (\n        SELECT 1 FROM \"public\".\"financial_allocation_sets\" successor\n        WHERE successor.supersedes_set_id = allocation_set.id\n      )\n  )\n  SELECT (\n    issue_row.state = 'open' AND\n    issue_row.safe_code IN (\n      'allocation_fork', 'allocation_incomplete', 'allocation_mismatch',\n      'classification_fork', 'correction_rebase_required', 'currency_mismatch',\n      'immutable_mismatch', 'missing_source', 'source_linkage_mismatch'\n    ) AND EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 FROM \"public\".\"refunds\" refund\n      WHERE refund.id = command_refund_id\n    ) AND (\n      (issue_row.resource_type = 'refund' AND\n        issue_row.resource_id = command_refund_id) OR\n      (issue_row.resource_type = 'allocation_set' AND EXISTS (\n        SELECT 1\n        FROM current_selected_set_lineage lineage\n        JOIN current_refund_sets current_set ON current_set.id = lineage.id\n      ))\n    )\n  ) IS TRUE INTO allowlisted_issue;\n  IF allowlisted_issue IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '55000',\n      MESSAGE = 'financial issue is outside the administrator command scope';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM pg_catalog.set_config(\n    'pale_orbit.plan6bii_financial_admin_issue_resolution_command_id',\n    command_row.id::text, true\n  );\n  PERFORM pg_catalog.set_config(\n    'pale_orbit.plan6bii_financial_admin_issue_resolution_issue_id',\n    issue_row.id::text, true\n  );\n  PERFORM pg_catalog.set_config(\n    'pale_orbit.plan6bii_financial_admin_issue_resolution_actor_id',\n    command_row.actor_user_id::text, true\n  );\n  UPDATE \"public\".\"financial_reconciliation_issues\"\n  SET state = 'resolved', resolved_by_admin_id = command_row.actor_user_id,\n    resolved_at = pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()\n  WHERE id = issue_row.id AND state = 'open'\n  RETURNING * INTO resolved_issue;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RETURN;\n  END IF;\n  INSERT INTO \"public\".\"audit_events\" (\n    actor_type, actor_id, action, outcome, resource_type, resource_id,\n    correlation_id, after\n  ) VALUES (\n    'user'::\"public\".\"audit_actor_type\", command_row.actor_user_id::text,\n    'financial.issue.resolved', 'succeeded'::\"public\".\"audit_outcome\",\n    'financial_issue', resolved_issue.id::text, command_row.correlation_id,\n    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(\n      'resourceType', resolved_issue.resource_type,\n      'resourceId', resolved_issue.resource_id,\n      'safeCode', resolved_issue.safe_code,\n      'impact', resolved_issue.impact,\n      'state', resolved_issue.state,\n      'occurrenceCount', resolved_issue.occurrence_count,\n      'commandId', command_row.id\n    )\n  );\n  RETURN NEXT resolved_issue;\n  RETURN;\nEND;\n$function$\n", "volatility": "v", "security_definer": true, "identity_arguments": "uuid, uuid"}$catalog$::jsonb),

\"public\".\"financial_admin_job_claims\"%ROWTYPE;\n  terminal_at timestamptz;\nBEGIN\n  IF OLD.type IS DISTINCT FROM 'commerce.financial-admin-command' AND\n    NEW.type IS DISTINCT FROM IS NULL OR\n    OLD.locked_by IS NULL OR\n    NEW.locked_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.locked_by IS NOT NULL OR\n    NEW.completed_at IS NULL OR NEW.attempts IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.attempts OR\n    NEW.type IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.type OR NEW.payload IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.payload OR\n    NEW.deduplication_key IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.deduplication_key OR\n    NEW.max_attempts IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.max_attempts THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '55000',\n      MESSAGE = 'invalid financial administrator job terminal transition';\n  END IF;\n  SELECT * INTO claim_row\n  FROM \"public\".\"financial_admin_commands\" command\n  WHERE command.job_id = NEW.id\n    AND NEW.payload IS NOT DISTINCT FROM\n      pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('commandId', command.id)\n    AND    MESSAGE = 'financial administrator job has no linked command';\n  END IF;\n  IF NEW.status = 'succeeded' THEN\n    IF command_row.status <> 'succeeded' THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = "language": "plpgsql", "parallel": "u", "leakproof": false, "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.plan6bii_guard_administrative_grant_transition()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET \"public\".\"financial_admin_command_kind\";\n  command_input jsonb;\n  guarded_row \"public\".\"entitlement_grants\"%ROWTYPE;\nBEGIN\n  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN\n    guarded_row := OLD;\n  ELSE\n    guarded_row := NEW;\n  END IF;\n  IF (TG_OP = 'INSERT' AND NEW.source <> 'administrative') OR\n    (TG_OP = 'DELETE' AND OLD.source <> 'administrative') OR\n    (TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.source <> 'administrative' AND\n      NEW.source <> 'administrative') THEN\n    IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN\n      RETURN OLD;\n    END IF;\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' OR\n    (TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND NEW.source IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.source) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '55000',\n      MESSAGE = 'administrative entitlement transition is reserved';\n  END IF;\n  SELECT pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(routine.proowner)\n  INTO transition_owner\n  FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc routine\n  WHERE routine.oid = pg_catalog.to_regprocedure(\n    'public.transition_administrative_recovery_grant_after_admin_command(uuid)'\n  );\n  command_identity := pg_catalog.current_setting(\n    'pale_orbit.plan6bii_administrative_grant_command_id', true\n  );\n  job_identity := pg_catalog.current_setting(\n    'pale_orbit.plan6bii_administrative_grant_job_id', true\n  );\n  reference_identity := pg_catalog.current_setting(\n    'pale_orbit.plan6bii_administrative_grant_reference_id', true\n  );\n  IF current_user IS DISTINCT FROM transition_owner OR\n    command_identity IS NULL OR\n    NOT pg_catalog.pg_input_is_valid(command_identity, 'uuid') OR\n    job_identity IS NULL OR NOT pg_catalog.pg_input_is_valid(job_identity, 'uuid') OR\n    reference_identity IS NULL OR\n    NOT pg_catalog.pg_input_is_valid(reference_identity, 'uuid') OR\n    guarded_row.source IS DISTINCT FROM 'administrative' OR\n    guarded_row.state_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'refund_allocation_recovery' OR\n    guarded_row.order_item_id IS NOT NULL OR guarded_row.user_id IS NULL OR\n    guarded_row.title_id IS NULL OR\n    guarded_row.recovery_refund_allocation_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM reference_identity THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '55000',\n      MESSAGE = 'administrative entitlement transition is reserved';\n  END IF;\n  SELECT command.kind, command.private_input\n  INTO command_kind, command_input\n  FROM \"public\".\"financial_admin_commands\" command\n  WHERE command.id::text = command_identity\n    AND command.job_id::text = job_identity\n    AND command.status = 'pending'\n    AND (\n      command.kind = 'administrative_recovery_activate' OR\n      command.kind = 'administrative_recovery_deactivate'\n    );\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '55000',\n      MESSAGE = 'administrative entitlement transition is reserved';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF command_kind = 'administrative_recovery_activate' THEN\n    IF NOT ((\n      pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(command_input) = 'object' AND\n      pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(command_input -> 'finalizationEffectId') = 'string' AND\n      pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(command_input -> 'orderItemId') = 'string' AND\n      CASE WHEN pg_catalog.pg_input_is_valid(\n          command_input ->> 'finalizationEffectId', 'uuid'\n        ) THEN EXISTS (\n          SELECT 1\n          FROM \"public\".\"refund_allocation_finalization_effects\" effect\n          JOIN \"public\".\"entitlement_grants\" purchase\n            ON purchase.id = effect.purchase_grant_id\n           AND purchase.order_item_id = effect.order_item_id\n          WHERE effect.id = (command_input ->> 'finalizationEffectId')::uuid\n            AND effect.order_item_id::text = command_input ->> 'orderItemId'\n            AND effect.refund_allocation_id =\n              guarded_row.recovery_refund_allocation_id\n            AND effect.transition = 'revoked_by_finalization'\n            AND purchase.source = 'purchase'\n            AND purchase.user_id = guarded_row.user_id\n            AND purchase.title_id = guarded_row.title_id\n        ) ELSE false END AND\n      guarded_row.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'revoked' AND\n      guarded_row.state IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'active' AND\n      (\n        (TG_OP = 'INSERT' AND guarded_row.revoked_at IS NULL) OR\n        (TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.state = 'revoked' AND\n          OLD.id = NEW.id AND OLD.user_id = NEW.user_id AND\n          OLD.title_id = NEW.title_id AND\n          OLD.recovery_refund_allocation_id =\n            NEW.recovery_refund_allocation_id AND\n          NEW.revoked_at IS NULL)\n      )\n    ) IS TRUE) THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '55000',\n        MESSAGE = 'administrative entitlement transition is reserved';\n    END IF;\n  ELSE\n    IF NOT ((\n      TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.id = NEW.id AND OLD.state = 'active' AND\n      guarded_row.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'active' AND\n      guarded_row.state IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'revoked' AND\n      guarded_row.revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND\n      guarded_row.revoked_at = guarded_row.updated_at AND\n      pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(command_input) = 'object' AND\n      pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(command_input -> 'recoveryGrantId') = 'string' AND\n      command_input ->> 'recoveryGrantId' = guarded_row.id::text AND\n      pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(command_input -> 'recoveryReferenceId') = 'string' AND\n      command_input ->> 'recoveryReferenceId' =\n        guarded_row.recovery_refund_allocation_id::text AND\n      pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(command_input -> 'expectedStateChangedAt') = 'string' AND\n      pg_catalog.pg_input_is_valid(\n        command_input
